component.title: Channel chip
component.purpose: Marks which channel a thread, message or binding belongs to, using identity read from the channel descriptor so a new channel needs no change here.

states.description: A channel identity on a thread row.
The channel is the active filter.

claims.statement: The chip's label and accent are read from the channel descriptor, with no per-channel branch in the component.
claims.rationale: OT-P0-002. A chip with a switch on channel id is the first place the descriptor stops being the source of truth.

claims.statement: Channel accent is applied as an edge or mark rather than as a filled background.
claims.rationale: A list of filled, differently-coloured chips is unreadable at roster density.

claims.statement: The chip announces the channel name rather than a decorative glyph alone.
Every channel accent holds contrast on both grounds.
